title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 91 (Rwai Lum bad Wah Vol. 13)
khasi_title: Rwai Lum bad Wah Ba-paka No. 91
cultural_context: Laments tragic legends and honors sacred rivers, peaks, and monoliths. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
U Tirot Sing u syiem ba shlur,
U la ieng pyrshah ia ki nongwei;
U ong: 'Kham bha ban iap kum u riewshlur,
Ban ia kaba shong mraw ha la ka ri!'
lyrics_english:
U Tirot Sing, the fearless ruler,
Stood resolute against the foreign invader;
He declared: 'Far better to die as a free warrior,
Than live as a subjugated slave on our own soil!'
